definitions.explanation: A thin, pointed metal instrument used for sewing, knitting, or medical purposes.
The pointer on a clock or gauge that indicates the time or measurement.
Short for {鍼|はり}{治療|ちりょう} (acupuncture treatment).

examples.japanese: {針|はり}に{糸|いと}を{通|とお}す。
{時計|とけい}の{針|はり}が12{時|じ}を{指|さ}している。
examples.english: The hands of the clock point to 12 o'clock.

examples.japanese: {腰痛|ようつう}で{針|はり}を{打|う}ってもらった。
examples.english: I had acupuncture for my back pain.
examples.notes: 針を打つ = to have acupuncture

notes:
USAGE: {針|はり} refers to needles in general and clock hands. In medical contexts, it often means acupuncture.

TYPES OF NEEDLES:
・{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり} (sewing needle)
・{編|あ}み{針|ばり} (knitting needle)
・{注射|ちゅうしゃ}{針|ばり} (injection needle)
・{釣|つ}り{針|ばり} (fishhook)

CLOCK-RELATED:
・{長|なが}い{針|はり} (minute hand)
・{短|みじか}い{針|はり} (hour hand)
・{秒|びょう}{針|しん} (second hand)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{針|はり}の{穴|あな}を{通|とお}すよう (like threading a needle - very difficult)
・{針小棒大|しんしょうぼうだい} (making a mountain out of a molehill)
